analysis: The gated residual trial completed successfully but achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.525, below the reported next-item reference of 0.5737 by 0.0487 and the reported two-step variant of 0.5613 by 0.0363. Category HR@10 was 0.560 Movies_and_TV, 0.555 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.415 Electronics, and 0.570 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics had the lowest absolute score; category-level reference scores are unavailable, so regression cannot be attributed to a particular category. The result does not support this immediate-item bypass configuration. A possible explanation is that adding normalized local embeddings perturbs useful recurrent representations, but the supplied results contain no learned-gate diagnostics to establish the mechanism. No hidden-test results were supplied.
code_summary: Trained one independent two-layer GRU network per category with 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, input LayerNorm, dropout 0.25, projected normalized states, learned item bias, and learned score scale. The architectural change adds h + sigmoid(Linear([h, local])) * local before output dropout and projection; gate weights start at zero and bias at -2. Training uses next-item-only supervision, eight uniformly sampled negatives excluding the position's positive, a softplus objective, AdamW, and seed 42. Each category selects one checkpoint by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. The predictor routes all four categories, reconstructs the same architecture, and strictly loads one checkpoint per category. Code includes initial finite-gradient checks and selected-checkpoint reload prediction parity checks. No ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is used.
